change_reason: A real train/validation control run under v2 failed before evaluating any control because checksum-locked ARC-Challenge contains a small number of questions with three or five choices, while v2 simultaneously froze an all-row budget and a four-choice classifier. V3 resolves that pre-test protocol contradiction with a deterministic feature-only eligibility rule: retain exactly-four-choice questions, preserve source order, and record every exclusion. No confirmatory test data was downloaded or evaluated before this correction.
scientific_question: Does LAM-JEPA improve held-out grade-school science multiple-choice accuracy over fair non-JEPA baselines on the protocol-eligible AI2 ARC-Challenge subset under a predeclared evaluation protocol?

in_scope: grade-school science multiple-choice reasoning on exactly-four-choice AI2 ARC-Challenge questions
calibration on the same eligible multiple-choice task
contribution of the latent-action planner and EMA target mechanism to this eligible ARC result
out_of_scope: performance on ARC questions with other than four answer choices

dataset.name: AI2 ARC-Challenge

eligibility.rule: retain a row if and only if len(choices) == 4
eligibility.decision_basis: question structure only; answer labels, predictions, model outputs, and performance are forbidden from eligibility decisions
eligibility.ordering: preserve original checksum-locked split order among retained rows
eligibility.exclusions: retain excluded item IDs, original choice counts, counts, and ordered-ID digests as evidence; no other exclusion rule is permitted

split_policy.train: training only after the frozen eligibility rule
split_policy.validation: development, debugging, and model selection only after the frozen eligibility rule
split_policy.test: single confirmatory evaluation stage after protocol, implementation, and validation-stage choices are frozen; apply the already-frozen eligibility rule only after locked test access begins

dataset.leakage_rule: Any overlapping eligible item ID across train, validation, or test invalidates the run. Test labels, test eligibility counts, test excluded IDs, or test-derived metrics must not influence model or hyperparameter selection before confirmatory access.

training_budget.train_examples: all checksum-locked train rows eligible under len(choices) == 4
training_budget.validation_examples: all checksum-locked validation rows eligible under len(choices) == 4
training_budget.test_examples: all checksum-locked test rows eligible under len(choices) == 4, selected only after confirmatory test access begins
training_budget.budget_rule: LAM-JEPA and the matched-capacity supervised baseline use identical eligible rows, epochs, batch size, seeds, optimizer family, and evaluation passes. The pretrained baseline uses the same eligible rows, epochs, batch size, seeds, and evaluation passes; model-specific learning rate is predeclared and compute plus parameter counts must be reported rather than described as parameter matched.

matched_capacity_supervised_baseline.parameter_accounting: Match the exact number of LAM-JEPA parameters that are gradient-active under the ARC training objective. Measure capacity by running the exact _lam_arc_loss backward pass on LAMARCClassifier and summing parameters for which grad is not None. Do not count EMA-only target parameters, auxiliary heads disconnected from the ARC loss, or buffers. Record active and inactive parameter names and counts as evidence.
matched_capacity_supervised_baseline.forward_path_requirement: All counted matched-baseline parameters must be gradient-active under its supervised ARC loss on the same accounting check.

strong_pretrained_baseline.parameter_matching: not parameter matched; report exact trainable and total parameters plus training wall time or equivalent compute evidence

metrics.uncertainty: paired seed-level 95% bootstrap confidence interval for LAM-JEPA minus each trained baseline

robustness.choice_order: deterministically reverse answer choices with exact label remapping and retain per-example paired predictions
robustness.failure_rule: A superiority claim is invalid if LAM-JEPA loses more than 0.05 absolute accuracy under the choice-order transform or is more than 0.02 worse than the strongest trained baseline on the same robustness delta.

negative_control.split: eligible validation only; never use confirmatory test labels for the negative control
negative_control.failure_rule: If the shuffled-label LAM-JEPA exceeds 0.35 eligible-validation accuracy, stop and investigate leakage or shortcut behavior before any test evaluation.

ablations.mechanism_claim_rule: Do not attribute the eligible ARC result to a component unless the paired full-minus-ablation mean accuracy is at least 0.01 and its paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval excludes zero.
ablations.student_state: No student-state contribution claim is made from ARC-Challenge, so this protocol does not use ARC to validate student-state modeling.

claim_gate.superiority: LAM-JEPA may be described as outperforming a baseline only if the mean absolute accuracy gain is at least 0.02 and the paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the seed-level accuracy delta excludes zero.
claim_gate.strongest_baseline_rule: Any headline superiority claim must hold against the strongest trained non-JEPA baseline, not only the majority reference or matched scratch baseline.
claim_gate.negative_results: If the gate fails, retain all raw outputs and report the negative or inconclusive result without changing the protocol after seeing test outcomes.

required: eligibility report for every accessed split
excluded item IDs and choice counts
training duration or equivalent compute evidence
aggregate statistics derived from raw seed records
artifact_contract.independent_qa: Lane 08 must reproduce the immutable result commit before any RESEARCH_COMPLETE classification.

protocol_change_rule: V1 and V2 remain immutable audit trails. V3 supersedes V2 before confirmatory test access. Any material change after V3 is merged requires a new protocol version before confirmatory test access. Never silently edit V1, V2, or V3 in response to observed confirmatory test results.
